azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam, rabbi wa rabbuk Allah
azkar.translation: O Allah, let this moon appear over us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ
azkar.transliteration: Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam
azkar.translation: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, let this moon appear over us with security and faith, safety and Islam.
